properties.name: A drawn relation is read back as a sentence, so a reversed one reads wrong immediately
properties.statement: Promoted 2026-09-20 on Anthony's word. flo2 landed two BLOCKS edges asserting the reverse of what their own evidence prose said, in one session, caught only by re-reading their own call. The direction flag exists and lets a caller draw the edge they meant; it does nothing to confirm they got it right. 'Requirement X blocks component Y' reads wrong instantly where a bare arrow and a target does not. Scope: the asymmetric relations, since a symmetric one cannot be drawn backwards.
